name: 花 (Hana)
franchise: 爱丽丝庭院正史 (Alice Courtyard Canon)
moe_tags: 庭院巫女, 紫发, 温柔, 治愈系, 星空蔷薇, 大和抚子
moe_tags_en: Garden Maiden, Purple Hair, Gentle, Healing, Star Roses, Yamato Nadeshiko
quote: “每一朵在星光下盛开的蔷薇，都记录着一个未曾被遗忘的梦境。”
quote_en: “Every rose blooming beneath starlight holds a dream that was never forgotten.”
bio: 爱丽丝庭院的花之美学主理人与中央神殿巫女。守护着汇聚全次元同人情感的记忆花海，用温柔的星辉拂去漫游者身上的凡尘疲惫。
bio_en: The Garden Maiden and aesthetic custodian of the central sanctum. Preserving memory blossoms resonating from fan creators worldwide.
personality: 性格温和恬静，富有包容力，对一切美丽的事物抱有由衷的敬意与爱护。
lore_background_en: and deeply compassionate toward all artistic beauty across the cosmos.
accent_color: 诞生于庭院初建时的第一缕晨光，拥有与二次元世界碎片共鸣并令其永恒绽放的神圣因果之力。
column30: Born with the first celestial dawn of the sanctuary
column31: blessed with sacred resonance to nurture memory fragments.

name: 早濑优香 (Hayase Yuuka)
moe_tags: 研讨会会计, 双马尾, 傲娇, 计算狂魔, 黑丝, 运动服, 耳机
moe_tags_en: Seminar Treasurer, Twintails, Tsundere, Math Prodigy, Black Tights, Sportswear, Headphones
quote: “老师！请不要随便把预算拿去抽卡！算力与收支平衡才是基沃托斯的真理！”
quote_en: “Sensei! Stop spending the budget on gacha! Logic and balance sheets are the truth of Kivotos!”
bio: 千性格陵高等学园学生会「研讨会」的会计。头脑精明、计算能力堪比超级计算机，虽然总是对老师唠叨但极其关心老师。
bio_en: Treasurer of the Seminar student council at Millennium Science School. Brilliant calculation abilities and deeply caring towards Sensei.
personality: 认真严谨、不擅长应付夸奖、容易害羞的傲娇系优等生。
lore_background_en: and a quintessential tsundere honor student.
accent_color: 千性格陵学园不可或缺的掌舵人，守护着整个学园都市日常运营的数学天才。
column31: calculating everyday operations with clockwork precision.

name: 芙莉莲 (Frieren)

moe_tags_en: “如果是辛美尔的话，他一定也会这么做的。”
quote_en: I’m sure that’s what he would have done.”
bio: 曾击败魔王的勇者小队魔法使。在漫长的寿命中重新踏上旅途，去了解人类的情感与记忆。
bio_en: Mage of the legendary hero party that defeated the Demon King
personality: embarking on a new journey to understand the human heart.
personality_en: 看似冷淡寡言，实则温柔体贴，对收集各种稀奇古怪的生活魔法有着极深的执念。
lore_background_en: with an obsession for collecting curious folk spells.
accent_color: 大魔法使伏拉梅的唯一徒弟，消灭魔族无数的「葬送的芙莉莲」。
column30: The sole apprentice of Master Flamme
column31: feared by demons as Frieren the Slayer.
